class.name: RealityPortalMeshInstance3D
class.brief_description: Creates a portal in the shape of the mesh assigned.
class.description:
This maps to RealityKit's [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/PortalComponent]PortalComponent[/url].
The shape of the portal is defined by the mesh on this node. Whereas the world inside the portal is defined by the [b]target_node[/b] assigned, and all its descendants.

method.name: get_flag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param flag] is set.

method.name: set_flag
method.description: Sets or clears the given [param flag].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], a clipping plane is applied to the portal content at the position and normal defined by [member clipping_plane_position] and [member clipping_plane_normal].
Normal direction of the clipping plane in the portal's local space.
Position of the clipping plane in the portal's local space.

If [code]true[/code], a crossing plane is defined at the position and normal given by [member crossing_plane_position] and [member crossing_plane_normal]. Use with [RealityPortalCrossing3D] to allow objects to visually cross through the portal.
Normal direction of the crossing plane in the portal's local space.
Position of the crossing plane in the portal's local space.
Root node of all the content inside the portal.
